prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after selection) was helpful (+13.0%).
Redesigning screens with interactive elements (waiting screen redesign) hurt performance (-7.6%).
Adding guidelines/hints (photo quality guidelines) had no clear effect.
Predictions for flow reordering were accurate (+12.0% predicted vs +13.0% measured).
Predictions were far too high for visual redesigns (+8.0% predicted vs -7.6% measured) and hints (+4.0% predicted vs no clear effect).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -7.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +13.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Background Waiting Desktop Notification: Adds desktop notification toggle and accurate completion time estimate to the waiting screen so users can minimize the app. (why: Waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s; notifying users when ready prevents drop-off during long renders.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Clarify Account & Pet Sync on Sign-In: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in saves and syncs their pet data across logins. (why: Eight support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again due to account state confusion.)
2: [finish, layout] Desktop Quick Controls Split Layout: Changes the home_intro screen to a split layout highlighting primary desktop control actions and tips. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding control confusion.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Presets Fallback Choice on Photo Upload: Adds alternative pre-made pet template choices directly on the upload_photos screen as a fallback if photo upload fails or is skipped. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and mean time of 1017s; providing instant templates reduces friction.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Path Choice Screen Copy: Simplifies path selection headline and body copy to clearly distinguish pre-made pets from custom photo uploads. (why: Choose path mean time is 514s (median 8s), indicating decision hesitation for a segment of users.)
5: [finish, notification] First Desktop Summon Hint Notification: Enables completion notification hint on home_intro screen reminding users how to summon their pet. (why: Ensures smooth transition from onboarding completion to active desktop pet usage, addressing post-onboarding confusion.)
